title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated Copilot connectors read third-party data live through MCP
summary: Hold: the claim that no automation is documented for assigning a connector's users overlooks the beta Graph package-availability API for connectors distributed as plugins. The roadmap facts and licensing requirements are supported; the blocking route also needs fuller navigation and the tool-level control guidance needs its documented qualifications.

claims.claim: No automation is documented for choosing which users or groups get an individual federated connector.

claims.fix: For connectors delivered as plugin packages, set controls[3].api to graph, call 'PATCH /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/copilotpackagedetail-update'. This beta API requires Microsoft Agent 365; package availability is not installation or remote-service permission.' Replace the blanket staging-API absence in Governance controls and Open questions with 'Graph beta documents package user availability for connectors distributed as plugins; a direct connector Staged Rollout operation is not documented.' Do not claim that this endpoint sets a standalone connector's staging field.
